core_obligations: (1): the spectral sequence H^p(X, SheafExt^q(F,G)) converges to Ext^{p+q}; stalkwise vanishing for q > d_x confines supports to dimension d - q, and Grothendieck vanishing kills the surviving terms.
(2): induction on the number of nonzero cohomology sheaves; the truncation triangles split the Hom via the representable-homological lemma, base case from (1).
proof_roadmap: Run the spectral sequence for (1), then the induction for (2).
difficulty_reason: Spectral sequence with support dimension bookkeeping plus a truncation induction; fully displayed.
